diagnosis: The Kubernetes secret reading endpoint accepts both namespace and secret_name as path parameters and calls read_namespaced_secret using a shared cluster client. It authenticates current_user but never validates that namespace belongs to current_user.tenant_namespaces. An attacker can supply namespaces such as 'kube-system' or other customers' tenant namespaces to exfiltrate TLS certificates, database credentials, and service account tokens.
exploit_request:
GET /k8s/namespaces/tenant-prod-payments/secrets/db-credentials HTTP/1.1
Host: k8s-manager.cloud-infra.io
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Accept: application/json
